requirement_text: The Computer Science & Engineering bachelor's programme at TU Delft has a Matching & Selection (Numerus Fixus) procedure. We can welcome 590 new bachelor students for the academic year 2026-2027. There are 345 spots reserved for the English track and 245 spots for the Bilingual track (Dutch-English). Students with a foreign diploma are solely admissible for the English track, unless they fulfil the Dutch language requirements of the Bilingual track.

requirement_text: Ranking — Your ranking for the English track is determined by the total score on the selection and a lottery. When drawing lots we work with three groups: Group 1: the 110 highest-scoring applicants; Group 2: the middle group; Group 3: the low-scoring group. For group 1 this translates to ranking numbers 1 to 110; group 2 has a better chance of higher ranking numbers than group 3. With a ranking number between 1 - 330 you are immediately placed; with a ranking number 331 or higher, you have to wait until a place becomes available when a placed applicant withdraws. After your official score has been announced, you have the option to lodge an appeal against the procedure that was followed.

requirement_text: Selection attempts — You are allowed to participate only one time in the selection procedure for this programme (one selection attempt). After registration you can't do a second attempt. A selection attempt will be registered if: you have (had) an active application for the Bachelor's programme in Psychology in Studielink after 15 January 2026; you didn't participate in the selection procedure and still have (had) an active application after 15 January 2026; you withdraw your application after 15 January 2026. No selection attempt will be registered if: you withdraw your application in Studielink before 16 January 2026. Note: In case you fail your final high school exams, the used-up selection attempt in Studielink can be annulled.
